title: Champions & Clans
dek: First League was the summit, and the clans were the armies. Dynasties, a badge for ten titles, a trainer who won baseball and football in the same season, and a community team that took the crown on a tiebreaker.
stats: sports won in one season by 2cool
win pct that would have won it for Xtreme

chapters.title: DAS takes Season 95
chapters.text: DAS wins First League again with the Beatles. Beaner calls it the latest SmallBall dynasty. MarketWizard of the Chicago Mob finishes one step behind, again.
quotes: The real King came off his throne to congratulate me.

chapters.title: The ORRT is back
chapters.text: Slip'N'Sliders and Eddymvp revive the Official Round Robin Tournament for Season 104: 8–10★ teams only, two leagues of eight, and miss more than three games and you sit out a season. The Mayberry Bijou Sluggers of XsT win it. The thread title gives 2cool the congratulations.

chapters.title: A badge for ten titles
chapters.text: Commish decides it's time for a 10× First League wins badge, congratulating DAS and DE, and asks the forum to design it. Ideas range from ten bats in a circle to two 5-win badges colliding in an explosion. Mikes suggests just asking DarkElf what he wants.
quotes: I see its time (congrats Das and DE!)

chapters.title: 2cool wins both
chapters.text: 2cool wins Season 111 First League in baseball and football in the same season. Speed remembers when he hit 10★ with the standard trainer.
quotes: baseball and footy in the same season

chapters.title: Clan wars?
chapters.text: LXXVII 77 of )TUS( asks if there will ever be another clan wars. AcA, XsT and No-LiMiT- all answer the call. Everyone agrees it would be great and nobody can agree how to make it fair.
quotes: Slip'N'Sliders, on every team from every clan playing every other

chapters.title: Double Trouble by XsT
chapters.text: A weekly two-man tournament series. Wookie8662 and Lakers win the first two. Hawk and Money win the third. Smith and TRD beat Slip and Kindred in the fourth, playing Slip's community team 406751.

chapters.title: XsT wins PL1
chapters.text: The XsT community team takes First League in one of the tightest finishes anyone can remember, tied with paphillyman's Stormy and edging them on the lower team ID. DAS picks up the key win. The_Safo stays up for the final games for the first time ever.
quotes: Atta way boys! We got it done!
Community teams are making quite the showing recently.

sources: Congrats to DAS for winning Season #95 PL 1, Aug 2004
Congrats to 2cool for winning Season 111 PL 1 BB, Mar 2005
Is there going to be another clan wars?, Dec 2005
Double Trouble by XsT Winner's List, Feb 2006
